CBI arrests proclaimed offender in 2021 Bengal post-poll murder case

The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) has arrested Gopal Das, a proclaimed offender, in connection with a murder case stemming from the 2021 West Bengal post-poll violence. Das had been on the run for four years. The arrest was made by the CBI.
